_comment: The minisign key identity this project SHIPS. A test fails if the pubkey in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json stops matching this id. Replacing the publishing key is a breaking event for every installed build: they embed the previous public key and will reject new releases at download time, so it must be a deliberate, recorded decision and never a side effect of regenerating a key to work around a password problem.

active.note: Regenerated without a password on 2026-09-25 because the previous key's password had been lost. CONSEQUENCE, recorded rather than hidden: builds <=0.6.42 embed the previous key id 29F423F8EFA4DD7F and cannot auto-update across this boundary - they need one manual reinstall.

retired.note: Private key still exists at ~/.tauri/nulltrace.key, but its password is unrecoverable, so it can no longer sign. Kept for reference: it identifies which published signatures came from it.
